pipelines.reason_zh: 33 个应检查渠道均已得到明确结果：30 个已检查、1 个需要认证、2 个失败并记录原因。

pipelines.label: GitHub Engineering Intelligence
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 repositories were incrementally checked against current main-branch activity and release or changelog evidence.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 仓库均已按当前主分支活动及 Release/Changelog 证据完成增量检查。

pipelines.label_zh: 论文与研究成果情报发现
pipelines.reason: arXiv, OpenReview, OpenAI Research, Anthropic Research, Google DeepMind Research, and Microsoft Research were checked; three primary research artifacts were retained as signals.
pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查 arXiv、OpenReview、OpenAI Research、Anthropic Research、Google DeepMind Research 与 Microsoft Research，并保留 3 个主要研究成果信号。

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.selectedTitle: Verifiable completion for computer-use Digital Employees
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 计算机操作型数字员工的可验证完成机制
columns.reason: The primary research exposes a bounded completion-governance problem at the core of Digital Employee work: independent verification, process/outcome separation, failure attribution and false-positive control. It directly informs TMPA evidence envelopes and CodeFlowMu completion gates.
columns.reason_zh: 该主要研究揭示了数字员工工作的核心完成治理问题：独立验证、过程与结果分离、失败归因及误报控制。它可直接支撑 TMPA 证据封装与 CodeFlowMu 完成门禁。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the verifier methodology, evaluation set, agreement and false-positive measurements, process/outcome separation, failure taxonomy and applicability limits.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查验证器方法、评估集、一致性与误报指标、过程/结果分离、失败分类及适用边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.selectedTitle: Governed task-aware model routing for enterprise agent runtimes
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 企业 Agent 运行时的受治理任务感知模型路由
columns.reason: Cursor Router provides a concrete and testable architecture for task classification, model routing and enterprise controls. Official model-retirement and managed-settings signals provide cross-source support, turning the object into a bounded runtime-governance question rather than a product announcement.
columns.reason_zh: Cursor Router 提供了任务分类、模型路由与企业控制的具体可测试架构；官方模型退役和托管设置证据形成跨来源支持，使其成为边界明确的运行时治理问题，而非普通产品公告。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on routing inputs, policy precedence, enforcement boundaries, observability, fallback and migration behavior using the primary Router source and supporting official controls.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，基于 Router 主要来源及相关官方控制证据，核查路由输入、策略优先级、执行边界、可观测性、回退与迁移行为。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.selectedTitle: Persist governed session state only after output guardrails complete
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 仅在输出门禁完成后持久化受治理会话状态
columns.reason: The maintainer change exposes a precise implementation invariant: durable state must represent the governed outcome, not a provisional result. The mechanism is directly reproducible and relevant to TMPA evidence order, CodeFlowMu completion semantics and Digital Employee recovery.
columns.reason_zh: 该维护者变更揭示了精确的实现不变量：持久状态必须代表受治理的最终结果，而非临时结果。该机制可直接复现，并关联 TMPA 证据顺序、CodeFlowMu 完成语义与数字员工恢复。
columns.next: Execute Skill 03 Deep Reading on the commit diff, tests, non-stream and stream ordering, output-guardrail failure paths, persistence semantics and recovery implications.
columns.next_zh: 执行 Skill 03 深度阅读，核查提交差异、测试、非流式与流式顺序、输出门禁失败路径、持久化语义及恢复影响。

signals.title: GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will retire from Codex on August 31
signals.title_zh: GPT-5.4 与 GPT-5.4 mini 将于 8 月 31 日退出 Codex
signals.observedChange: OpenAI requires migration to GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna across workspace defaults, managed configurations, custom agents, and scheduled tasks.
signals.observedChange_zh: OpenAI 要求将相关工作区默认值、托管配置、自定义 Agent 与定时任务迁移到 GPT-5.6 Terra 与 Luna。

signals.title: ChatGPT converts pastes over 10,000 characters into attachments for all plans
signals.title_zh: ChatGPT 已面向所有套餐将超过 1 万字符的粘贴内容转为附件
signals.observedChange: Long pasted inputs are represented as attachments instead of directly consuming the composer and context window.
signals.observedChange_zh: 长文本粘贴将以附件表示，不再直接占用输入框与上下文窗口。

signals.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 preview adds multi-step orchestration and blocking physical-action calls
signals.title_zh: Gemini Robotics ER 2 预览版新增多步编排与物理动作阻塞式调用
signals.observedChange: Google released embodied-reasoning endpoints with agentic code execution, multi-step tool orchestration, progress classification, multi-robot coordination, and blocking function calls for physical actions.
signals.observedChange_zh: Google 发布具备 Agent 化代码执行、多步工具编排、进度分类、多机器人协作及物理动作阻塞式函数调用的具身推理端点。

signals.title: Cursor Router introduces task-aware model routing with team and enterprise controls
signals.title_zh: Cursor Router 引入按任务路由模型及团队与企业控制
signals.observedChange: Cursor Auto mode classifies task type and complexity, routes by cost, balance, or intelligence, and exposes team defaults, restrictions, allow/block lists, and enforcement controls.
signals.observedChange_zh: Cursor Auto 模式按任务类型与复杂度分类，在成本、平衡与智能模式间路由，并提供团队默认值、限制、模型允许/阻止列表及执行控制。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot cloud-agent automations can be triggered by issue and pull-request comments
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 云端 Agent 自动化现可由 Issue 与 PR 评论触发
signals.observedChange: Repository comment text can trigger governed cloud-agent automations for documentation, error investigation, and follow-up task creation.
signals.observedChange_zh: 仓库评论文本可触发文档生成、错误调查与后续任务创建等受治理的云端 Agent 自动化。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot managed settings support enterprise-team specialization
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 托管设置支持企业团队专门化配置
signals.observedChange: Enterprises can map specialized policy files to teams and add team plugins without weakening the enterprise policy floor.
signals.observedChange_zh: 企业可将专门化策略文件映射到团队，并在不削弱企业策略基线的前提下叠加团队插件。

signals.title: Copilot Studio combines enhanced orchestration, reusable skills, persistent memory, and Windows 365 control
signals.title_zh: Copilot Studio 整合增强编排、可复用技能、持久记忆与 Windows 365 控制
signals.observedChange: Microsoft documents an enhanced orchestration runtime, organizational-data grounding, reusable skills, per-user memory, and Windows 365 MCP operational control.
signals.observedChange_zh: Microsoft 记录了增强编排运行时、组织数据接入、可复用技能、按用户持久记忆及 Windows 365 MCP 操作控制。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python honors resolved approvals before policy checks
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 现于策略检查前识别已解决审批
signals.observedChange: The runtime fix prevents already-resolved approval state from being incorrectly re-evaluated by later policy checks.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该修复避免已解决的审批状态被后续策略检查错误地重新判定。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python defers non-stream session persistence until output guardrails finish
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents Python 将非流式会话持久化延后至输出门禁完成
signals.observedChange: Non-stream session state is no longer saved before output guardrails complete, aligning durable state with the governed outcome.
signals.observedChange_zh: 非流式会话状态不再于输出门禁结束前保存，使持久状态与受治理结果保持一致。

signals.title: Codex adds durable per-thread user submission queues
signals.title_zh: Codex 新增按线程持久化的用户提交队列
signals.observedChange: Codex added ordered thread-scoped submissions with pagination, editing, deletion, atomic reordering, capacity limits, and cleanup.
signals.observedChange_zh: Codex 增加按线程有序提交、分页、编辑、删除、原子重排、容量限制与清理。

signals.title: Codex hides explicit-only orchestrator skills from model-visible discovery
signals.title_zh: Codex 将仅显式调用的编排技能从模型可见发现目录中隐藏
signals.observedChange: Skills marked allow_implicit_invocation=false remain directly invocable but are excluded from the model-facing catalog.
signals.observedChange_zh: 标记 allow_implicit_invocation=false 的技能仍可直接调用，但不再出现在模型可见目录中。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.222 hardens worktree isolation and background-task permission enforcement
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.222 强化工作树隔离与后台任务权限执行
signals.observedChange: The release blocks destructive Git actions against the main checkout from isolated sessions, extends isolation to edits and Bash, and closes a background PreToolUse bypass.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该版本阻止隔离会话对主检出执行破坏性 Git 操作，将隔离扩展至编辑与 Bash，并修复后台 PreToolUse 绕过。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.78 expands worktree, permission, sandbox, managed-policy, and session controls
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.78 扩展工作树、权限、沙箱、托管策略与会话控制
signals.observedChange: The release adds a new-worktree flow, approval-mode switching, session-only sandbox bypass, managed-settings refresh, rewind, MCP refresh after OAuth, and faster long-session resume.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该版本新增新工作树流程、审批模式切换、仅会话级沙箱绕过、托管设置刷新、回退、OAuth 后 MCP 刷新及长会话快速恢复。

signals.title: OpenAI audit estimates roughly 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks are broken
signals.title_zh: OpenAI 审计估计 SWE-Bench Pro 约 30% 任务存在缺陷
signals.observedChange: OpenAI combined automated filtering, investigator agents, and expert annotation, then retracted its earlier recommendation to adopt SWE-Bench Pro.
signals.observedChange_zh: OpenAI 结合自动筛查、调查 Agent 与专家标注，并撤回此前采用 SWE-Bench Pro 的建议。

signals.title: AgentLens evaluates complete coding-agent trajectories rather than pass/fail alone
signals.title_zh: AgentLens 评估完整编码 Agent 轨迹，而非仅看通过或失败
signals.observedChange: The benchmark combines formal verification, trajectory reviews, and side-by-side comparisons to diagnose behavior and detect regressions.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该基准结合形式验证、轨迹审查与并排比较，用于诊断行为并发现回归。

signals.title: Microsoft Universal Verifier separates process, outcome, and controllable failure for computer-use agents
signals.title_zh: Microsoft Universal Verifier 为计算机使用 Agent 分离过程、结果与可控失败
signals.observedChange: The work reports human-level agreement, near-zero false positives relative to prior baselines, process/outcome separation, and controllable/uncontrollable failure scoring.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该研究报告了接近人类一致性的判断、相较既有基线近乎为零的误报，以及过程/结果和可控/不可控失败分离。
